candidates.name: Finite enumeration / grid
candidates.evidence: Grid and brute-force sampler families are documented; tiny domains can be fully enumerated.
candidates.limitations: Combinatorial growth; no full architecture search claim.
candidates.reason: P1 mandatory control despite lower fit for large spaces.

candidates.name: Seeded random / QMC
candidates.evidence: Random and QMC sampler families are documented.
candidates.limitations: Conditional parameters and invalid candidate density require explicit handling.
candidates.reason: Mandatory unbiased comparator; no assumed sample efficiency.

candidates.name: Optuna conditional TPE
candidates.evidence: Official sampler guide discusses conditional search spaces and TPE.
candidates.limitations: Constraint and multi-objective behavior must be pinned to tested version; HAT performance unmeasured.
candidates.reason: Practical contender for discrete conditional assets and schedules.

candidates.name: BoTorch multi-objective Bayesian optimization
candidates.role: sample-efficient exploration when evaluation is expensive and surrogate is valid
candidates.evidence: Official tutorials cover noisy parallel multi-objective and constrained optimization.
candidates.limitations: Separate cited versions; implementation must pin one supported release and validate APIs. Surrogate domain shift, dimensionality and hypervolume reference require evaluation.
candidates.reason: High-priority P3 experiment; not a reason to skip simpler baselines.

candidates.name: pymoo NSGA-II / NSGA-III
candidates.evidence: Official algorithm descriptions expose population and multi-objective mechanisms.
candidates.limitations: Population evaluation cost, constraint repair and categorical encoding may dominate.
candidates.reason: Useful independent comparator when surrogate assumptions are weak.

candidates.name: KG/LLM-guided bounded beam (proposed)
candidates.evidence: Graph retrieval is a supporting capability; this DSE search algorithm is a new design proposal, not a verified GraphRAG feature.
candidates.limitations: No DSE benchmark evidence; require legality gates, duplicate detection, replay and comparison with numeric optimizers.
candidates.reason: Necessary research direction for structural innovation; highest uncertainty, not first optimizer to trust.
